title: consolidate-stream-delta-frames-and-toolcall-boundary-logprob-normalization
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: Customers observed duplicated tokens and inconsistent stop/logprob envelopes when model-generated tool calls crossed stream fragment boundaries. This PR consolidates per-chunk delta framing, normalizes per-message logprob envelopes so they are stable across stream fragmentation, and attaches an explicit 'toolcall-boundary' marker to the streaming envelope to make downstream consumers (SDKs and the OpenAI-compat layer) tolerant of partial tool payloads.

What this PR does: checklist:
- [x] Introduce a streaming delta aggregator that coalesces adjacent small fragments into a single logical message before logprob synthesis.
- [x] Emit a compact JSON "toolcall-boundary" signal as part of the stream envelope when a tool/function call is started but not yet closed.
- [x] Normalize per-choice/logprob fields so cumulative token logprobs are identical whether received in one frame or multiple frames.
- [x] Add integration tests that simulate interleaved tool outputs and server pauses to reproduce previous duplication.
- [x] Update OpenAI /v1/chat.completions compatibility docs with the new stream framing notes and SDK migration guidance.

Notes on compatibility: The change is backward-compatible for consumers that parse framed JSON or the current streaming deltas. For older SDKs that expect one-token-per-delta semantics, we added a short migration section in docs and a compatibility header X-RW-Stream-Coalesce that defaults to true.

Commits summary: 
- Commit 1: runtime: add StreamDeltaAggregator and tests (src/runtime/stream_delta_aggregator.cc / .h).
- Commit 2: adapter: attach toolcall-boundary token to stream envelope and consumer flag (src/adapter/openai_compat/stream_coordinator.py).
- Commit 3: serializer: synthesize choice-level logprob when fragments are coalesced (src/adapter/openai_compat/response_serializer.py).
- Commit 4: tests: integration tests for toolcall crossing fragment boundaries (tests/integration/test_streaming_toolcalls.py).
- Commit 5: docs: openai compat page updated and changelog entry (docs/openapi/openai_v1_chat.md, CHANGELOG.md).

Files changed (high-level):
- src/runtime/stream_delta_aggregator.cc (new)
- src/runtime/stream_delta_aggregator.h (new)
- src/adapter/openai_compat/stream_coordinator.py (mod)
- src/adapter/openai_compat/response_serializer.py (mod)
- tests/integration/test_streaming_toolcalls.py (new)
- docs/openapi/openai_v1_chat.md (mod)
- CHANGELOG.md (mod)

Small illustrative snippet (response_serializer):
- Before: per-fragment logprobs were emitted raw and summed client-side causing rounding-diff duplication.
- After: when StreamDeltaAggregator reports coalesced=true we emit "choice_logprobs": {"tokens": [...], "sum_logprob": -12.34} so downstreams can trust a single canonical logprob.

Review conversation (abridged):
- Owen Park (reviewer): "This addresses a long-standing duplication bug — nice. Two asks: 1) ensure the X-RW-Stream-Coalesce header is documented in the SDKs, 2) can we keep the boundary marker compact (short key) to reduce bandwidth?"
- Maya Chen (author): "Agree on SDK docs, added a migration note. Kept marker as 'toolcall_boundary' for readability but happy to shorten if perf proves significant; added tests to measure envelope size."
- Diego Ramirez (reviewer): "Tests look good. I hit a failure locally in windows e2e: a race when aggregator flushes on connection reset. Suggest adding a small debounce before flush."
- Maya Chen: "Added 50ms debounce and a unit test for connection resets. Verified no perf regression on local bench."
- Priya Nair (approver): "Approved. Verification on staging passed for the two largest customers that previously reported the issue."

CI summary: "build: pass; unit-tests: failed initially (stream-fragment-test) due to missing debounce, rerun: pass; integration: pass; lint: pass; e2e (staging): pass; overall: pass after rerun"

Performance/regression checks: 
- microbench: <2% median latency increase for small messages, 0% regression at 95th p95 for standard workloads.
- bandwidth: single-digit percent increase when coalescing small fragments; default header can disable coalescing on bandwidth-constrained customers.

Release notes:
- "Fix duplicated tokens and inconsistent logprob envelopes during streaming when tool/function calls cross fragment boundaries. Adds an optional streaming envelope marker for in-progress tool calls and a coalescing mode to improve logprob stability across frames."

Related Linear: ENG-1943, ENG-2018.

Breakdown of changes and rationale (in one line each):
- StreamDeltaAggregator: centralizes fragment merging to avoid ad-hoc client-side heuristics.
- toolcall-boundary marker: makes partial tool payloads observable by SDKs so they can delay handler invocation until call is complete if desired.
- choice_logprobs emission: prevents different aggregation orders from changing final reported logprob sums.

Merge: squash and merge. Merged by Maya Chen on 2026-02-22.
